name: campusflow-monorepo
description: CampusFlow — Unified Campus Services Platform for Ethiopian Universities

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @campusflow/contracts build && pnpm --filter @campusflow/api build && pnpm --filter @campusflow/web build
scripts.test:mobile: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('flutter test', { cwd: 'apps/mobile', stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.analyze:mobile: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('flutter analyze', { cwd: 'apps/mobile', stdio: 'inherit' });"
